1.

No silver, no gold has acquired my salvation, No earthly treasures have freed my soul. No, the blood on the cross is the price I have cost, The only-begotten Son was given for my good.

C.

Redeemed I am, yet not with silver, Delivered, yet not with gold. O what a price! With precious blood God has blotted out all my guilt.

2.

No silver, no gold has erased my debt, No, for this my debt was too great and too heavy; Only the blood on the cross could remove it, Only therein do I receive deliverance from sin.

3.

No silver, no gold could, when I was afar, Win me access to God and His grace; But the blood on the cross, it brought me near. What depth and what height in the counsel of the Eternal!
